outcome.technical: NEW tools/plan-window.py (stdlib, 3.8 dialect, bootstrap shaped like tools/bench-report.py, no --selftest of its own). It holds the window selection that used to be the live_plan_window heredoc in tools/verify.sh, split into pure functions: key_paths, shape, references, select, narrow, disagreements. It also holds the disk steps snapshot, write_window, evidence and build, and main(<plan> <dst>), which exits 0, 1 (the readings differ) or 2 (usage, an unsharded plan, or a ledger outside the project). R33: the selection is extracted, and verify.sh's live_plan_window is now two lines: `python3 tools/plan-window.py docs/audit/audit-plan.json "$1"` and then validate-manifest. Its comment now covers only the wiring. R17: the fixed recent-done count (the literal third argument) is dropped. The basis is written beside the selection: over this repo's plan that arm added no key, status or evidence word the other arms did not already keep, so its only effect was size. R18: shape() now reads every key path recursively (a.b, a[].b). A dict holding any non-name key is a map keyed by data (tests.falsifiers is keyed by sentences) and is read as one `{}` path, so such phases do not all read as new. The CONTRIBUTING.md sentence now says key paths, nested keys included, and points at the tool and its suite. R31: main copies the plan, every shard it names, the ledger (resolved by _evidence_io.project_config_for + evidence_dir, so a config-moved ledger is carried to the same relative place) and the config ONCE into a tempfile snapshot. The selection, the window and both evidence readings then come from that snapshot, and the snapshot is removed in finally. gate-parity's lw2 now reads the full plan BEFORE running the step and re-reads it once on disagreement. R34: NEW tests/test_plan_window.py (21 cases, pw1-pw21) runs over a fixture plan whose shape is fixed in the suite. The fixture has a cross-phase dependsOn over two hops (P6.1->P2.1->P7.1), a materialized proposal on a dropped phase, a bug on a dropped task, a phase with a unique key (mergedHead), a phase whose only new shape is nested (outcome.filesTouched), and a phase new only by evidence. The suite asserts the closure, the shape and nested arms, the exact kept set (the over-fire twin), the proposal, bug and fileIndex filters, and shape-set equality including nested keys, computed by a key-path walk written in the suite itself so it is not compared with itself. It also covers the map collapse, every disagreements() branch, an end-to-end window on disk (record-shaped path, project is the window, kept shards only, resolved runs), the ledger-missing refusal (moved here from gate-parity's lw4), snapshot-only builds with the source tree deleted, main reading only snapshot and window paths, snapshot cleanup, and usage. tools/gate-parity.py: lw4 and _LIVE_WINDOW_LEDGER are removed (a selection/refusal case, now pw17). lw0 also asserts the function runs the tool exactly once; that literal is also the reach edge, so tools/affected.py selects gate-parity --selftest when only tools/plan-window.py changes (observed: `python3 tools/affected.py tools/plan-window.py` lists it). lw1-lw3 are kept as the wiring cases. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: a tree line beside tools/bench-report.py. On the live plan lw1 printed 35 of 158 phases kept (measured once). OUT-OF-SCOPE FILE NEEDED, NOT EDITED: tools/lints/_output_lints.py, one row in DEV_FILES: ("tools", os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "tools", "plan-window.py")). The reason is that the coverage classifier covers tools/ dev files only through DEV_DIRS/DEV_FILES. Without the row, (a) selftest_coverage() reports `orphans tests/test_plan_window.py`, so test__output_lints sc7 is red (observed, exit 1, 181/182) and a full sweep reports the orphan; and (b) suite_elsewhere_paths() does not list the tool, so the sweep walks it as a tool and runs `python3 tools/plan-window.py --selftest`, which exits 2 with usage (observed). tools/affected.py likewise prints `python3 tools/plan-window.py --selftest` because MIGRATED is read off the same table. The named-file sweep in the task gate does not fail on the orphan (exit 0, 8/8 files ok, 1888 cases), so it is not evidence that the gap is closed. The guide enumeration lint (_deps.guide_enumeration) is scoped to scripts/ and hooks/ and does not cover tools/, so the guide tree line is convention, not owed. _deps.LAYERS carries no tools/ file. DEPENDANTS: tools/verify.sh (.gitattributes, ci.yml, derive-phase-gate.py, test__output.py, test__refs.py, affected.py, check-example-pins.py, check-git-pipeline.py, ...) is still correct: only live_plan_window's body and comment changed, its name and the rendered_plan_legs call site are unchanged, gate-parity (both modes) passes, and test__refs 292/292 passes. tools/gate-parity.py: `_live_window_cases` named in verify.sh's comment is kept, and nothing else referenced _LIVE_WINDOW_LEDGER (git grep). tools/affected.py is unchanged and its selection is correct apart from the DEV_FILES-driven line above. tests/test__affected_tests.py, test__doctor_trail.py, test_drive_phase.py, _harness.py, test__deps.py, test__runner_collects.py, test_stamp_verification.py, tools/lints/_deps.py, tools/prove-gates.py, tools/sweep-selftests.py and stamp-verification.py are unchanged; all pass in the task's sweep, and prove-gates --selftest passes 66/66. Class left open: the one-status leg's heredoc in verify.sh repeats the fileIndex/bugs narrowing for an every-phase-done plan with proposals emptied. It is a different selection and outside these findings; it could call narrow() later.
outcome.descriptive: The live-plan window's selection is now a tested stdlib tool: it reads nested keys, has no unexplained recent-phase count, and takes both evidence readings from one snapshot. One row in tools/lints/_output_lints.py DEV_FILES is still needed for the full sweep to accept the new suite.
